B-COLD-FULL-REEXPLORATION.description: Full cold re-exploration: same real LLM agent solves the task from scratch with empty registry and no prior trajectory, executed via Playwright on localhost.
B-COLD-FULL-REEXPLORATION.expected: Succeeds on >=90% tasks but at full cost (100%). Repair must be <50% tokens and <40% browser steps on TEST to claim locality.
B-COLD-FULL-REEXPLORATION.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires real LLM API key

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.description: Verbatim mechanism replay without repair: stored mechanism from pre-perturbation executed unchanged on post-perturbation target via Playwright, no LLM patch.
B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.expected: Near 0% success post-perturbation (correctly fails). Demonstrates perturbation is breaking and repair adds value beyond trivial reuse.
B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires real LLM API key and Playwright execution

B-RETRIEVAL-RAG.description: Semantic retrieval over prior trajectory memory (embedding search + nearest successful trajectory replay) without patch, executed via Playwright.
B-RETRIEVAL-RAG.expected: Partial success 20-40%. Repair should exceed retrieval by >=30pp success on TEST.
B-RETRIEVAL-RAG.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires real LLM API key and embedding API

B-ORACLE-HAND-PATCH.description: Oracle hand-authored minimal patch (single selector/param/header correction) applied by experimenter, executed and verified via Playwright.
B-ORACLE-HAND-PATCH.expected: 100% success with 1 browser probe + 1 verification. Provides cost ceiling; measured autonomous repair should approach oracle within 2x tokens/steps.

B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY.description: Runtime verified substrate invariant: oracle-free decompression yields byte-identical decompressed bodies across HIT, SWR, SIE, and 304 stages on unperturbed resources.
B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY.expected: >=0.99 SHA256(body) identity HIT==SWR==SIE==304 pre-perturbation. If this baseline drifts <0.99, measurement is invalid per C-MEAS-VALID.
B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires nginx + Flask testbed setup

PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS.description: PC1 unperturbed execution succeeds; PC2 known-break single-attribute perturbation with oracle patch succeeds within 2 browser probes and verification passes, cost ratio <0.5 vs B-COLD.
PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS.expected: PC1 100% success, PC2 >=90% success with token ratio <0.5 vs B-COLD. If either fails, instrumentation is broken — triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires real LLM + Playwright + real verify() pipeline

NC-ZERO-AND-DISTANT-PERTURBATION.description: NC1 zero perturbation: repair pipeline must produce zero patch; NC2 distant unrelated perturbation: repair of A must be no-op. Random-patch false-accept <=5% and AUROC ~0.5.
NC-ZERO-AND-DISTANT-PERTURBATION.expected: NC1 repair cost = 0 patch tokens, NC1 contamination =0, NC2 contamination =0, random-patch false-accept <=5% and AUROC 0.4-0.6.

C1_PC_GATE.threshold: PC1 success=1.0 and PC2 repair success >=0.90 on real pipeline

C2_NC_GATE.threshold: NC1 patch cost 0 and NC2 contamination=0 and random-patch false-accept <=5% with AUROC 0.4-0.6

C3_BYTE_IDENTITY_GATE.threshold: B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY pre-perturbation byte identity >=0.99 on real nginx

C4_SUCCESS_GATE.threshold: repair success >=0.80 pooled AND >=0.70 per family on TEST

C5_COST_GATE.threshold: mean repair tokens <0.50*B-COLD AND mean browser <0.40*B-COLD AND mean verification steps <=2 on TEST

C7_VERIFICATION_GATE.threshold: verification AUROC >=0.75 and precision >=0.80 at operating threshold on TEST

C8_AMORTIZED_GATE.threshold: amortized cost at n_reuses=10 (repair+verification+10*retrieval) < B-COLD cost (both tokens and browser) on TEST means
